parameters.description: Timezone-aware window end; defaults to now. Normalized to UTC.

get.description:
Zero-filled UTC calendar hours intersecting [start, end); partial edge hours included.

A non-hour-aligned window has hours + 1 buckets. Stored timezone-aware timestamps
are normalized by the database expression so PostgreSQL session timezone cannot
shift the UTC calendar boundaries. SQLite stores this application's UTC dates
without offsets.

ComplaintClassification.title: ComplaintClassification
ComplaintClassification.description: Written by the AI classifier via PATCH /complaints/{id}/classification.

source_system.title: Source System
source_system.description: Identifier of the origin system, e.g. zendesk_sim

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: Unique ticket/case ID in the source system

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Support channel: call_center, call, in_app, email, or branch

occurred_at.title: Occurred At
occurred_at.description: Timezone-aware timestamp when the customer reported the issue

customer_ref.title: Customer Ref
customer_ref.description: CRM customer ID or phone (pseudonymized upon receipt)

ComplaintIngestIn.title: ComplaintIngestIn
ComplaintIngestIn.description:
Payload sent by bank support systems (CRM/Call Center/In-App).

extra='forbid' prevents clients from injecting bank_id, received_at,
or internal classification overrides.

ComplaintIngestResponse.title: ComplaintIngestResponse
ComplaintIngestResponse.description: Response returned upon durable acceptance (202) or idempotent replay (200).

DetectRequest.title: DetectRequest
DetectRequest.description: `now` lets the demo replay a simulated timeline. Omit it for live detection.

IncidentOverview.title: IncidentOverview
IncidentOverview.description: Single payload for tomorrow's frontend incident detail view.

InvestigationRunRequest.title: InvestigationRunRequest
InvestigationRunRequest.description: Explicit operator request. GET/dashboard reads never create runs.

open_incidents.title: Open Incidents
open_incidents.description: Current open statuses, across all time, excluding incidents detected or started after window_end. Not a historical status snapshot.

fraud_count.title: Fraud Count
fraud_count.description: Complaints with is_fraud=true in the window.

money_at_risk.title: Money At Risk
money_at_risk.description: Sum of complaint mentioned_amount only (all complaints, nulls ignored). Unverified reported exposure, NOT verified financial loss; may include duplicate reports.

avg_time_to_detect_seconds.title: Avg Time To Detect Seconds
avg_time_to_detect_seconds.description: Average seconds from incident started_at to detected_at for incidents in the window.

repeat_complaint_rate.title: Repeat Complaint Rate
repeat_complaint_rate.description: Fraction (0 to 1) of known customer_ref values that submitted more than one complaint in the window.

failed_rate.title: Failed Rate
failed_rate.description: Failed count / total count, a fraction from 0 to 1; zero for an empty window.

total_amount.title: Total Amount
total_amount.description: Sum of transaction amounts across all statuses, not a loss measure.

bucket_start.title: Bucket Start
bucket_start.description: UTC calendar-hour start; edge buckets may be partial.

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: Optional X handle to fetch mentions for (e.g. '@myaccessbank' or '@accessbank_help')

handles.title: Handles
handles.description: Optional list of X handles to fetch mentions for
